statement: Nscale is telling prospective investors its total contracted revenue has roughly doubled to about $103 billion, from $51 billion previously disclosed.
why: Contracted revenue at a single neocloud on this scale represents committed future compute purchases that have to be met with accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Signed multi-year compute leases oblige the operator to buy and install GPUs, power and colocation capacity to serve them.

evidence.excerpt: The signed lease contracts carry an average duration of 5.7 years, equating to an annualized average of roughly $18 billion.

confidence.basis: Secondary report of a report (The Information), with a source cautioning the metrics are illustrative and not formal revenue guidance, ahead of a possible IPO.

dispersion: Annualized average of roughly $18 billion over an average 5.7-year contract duration; figures described as illustrative.
